create.name: Emma Mumford
create.bio:
Emma Mumford is a manifestation teacher and life coach who works online from the UK. Before this work she spent several years in money saving: after an ex-partner left her with £7,000 of debt, she started Extreme Couponing and Deals UK in 2013, became known in the press as the 'Coupon Queen' and presented a regular slot on ITV's This Morning. She sold that business in 2018. A spiritual awakening in 2016, which followed the end of a relationship and a spell of severe depression, turned her towards personal development, and since 2017 she has taught the Law of Attraction full time.

She is a certified life coach and emotional healing coach, and she also uses EFT, inner child work and Integral Eye Movement Therapy. Her one-to-one Align sessions last ninety minutes over Zoom, and her online courses cover inner child work, calming the nervous system and learning to receive. She also leads day retreats, including one planned at Chalice Well in Glastonbury.

She hosts the podcast Aligned Abundance and has written four books, among them Positively Wealthy, Hurt, Healing, Healed and Aligned Abundance. Her YouTube channel mixes beginner lessons on manifesting, rituals for dates such as the Lion's Gate and 11/11, guided meditations and long subliminal tracks.

healer.no_public_base: Her site gives only the registered office of Emma Mumford Ltd (71-75 Shelton Street, Covent Garden, a company-formation address) and says sessions are on Zoom; no home town is published. Country United Kingdom from the company registration and her YouTube channel (GB).

books.title: Aligned Abundance: Release Expectations, Become Magnetic and Manifest the Life of Your Dreams
books.author: Emma Mumford
books.description: A guide to manifesting from a settled, embodied place rather than by chasing goals. It is built on three teachings, Attract, Alignment and Abundance, which also give her online course its name.

books.title: Hurt, Healing, Healed: Release Limiting Beliefs, Fears & Blocks to Supercharge Your Manifestation
books.author: Emma Mumford
books.description: Works through the fears and old beliefs that hold people back, pairing Law of Attraction teaching with meditations, journaling and practical exercises after every chapter for inner emotional work.

books.title: Positively Wealthy: A 33-Day Guide to Manifesting Sustainable Wealth
books.author: Emma Mumford
books.description: Thirty-three daily challenges aimed at shifting beliefs about money and success, drawing on her own path from debt to running a business.

books.title: The Positively Wealthy Journal
books.author: Emma Mumford
books.description: A companion journal to Positively Wealthy, with daily prompts and tips for working on money and manifesting goals.

courses.title: Align Session (one-to-one)
courses.description: A single ninety-minute coaching session over Zoom, booked as a one-off reset rather than ongoing coaching. Together they look at beliefs, fears and blocks around work, relationships, money or spiritual practice and leave with a plan of action.

courses.title: Inner Child Joy
courses.description: A six-week self-paced online programme in three stages, meeting, healing and transforming, each with a ninety-minute masterclass video, a workbook and a guided meditation for connecting with the inner child.

courses.title: Align: The Retreat (Glastonbury)
courses.description: A day retreat at Chalice Well in Glastonbury with a sound bath, meditation, journaling, scripting and EFT led by Emma, time in the gardens, a vegetarian lunch and an optional evening dinner. Limited to 22 places; the date is still to be confirmed.

free_resources.title: The Alignment Reset: Free 5-Day Challenge
free_resources.description: Five daily emails, each with a short teaching, journaling prompts and one simple action for the day. Signing up adds you to her mailing list.
